verdict.rationale: The evidence implies Justworks PEO provides health insurance. Companies are told to end their existing health insurance provider once their PEO start date is confirmed, and they receive customized quotes for the plans and pricing available on joining. Nothing documents administering employee benefit enrollments or syncing premium deductions into payroll; the fringe-benefit recording items cover benefits provided outside Justworks, so they don't count. Missing for 10: documented employee health plan enrollment workflow, benefit administration tooling for ops, automatic premium deduction sync to payroll, independent corroboration.
